Clinical Analysis & Research

This section contains synthesized clinical analysis, research documents, and comprehensive summaries of the medical journey.

Content Types

Treatment Response Analysis

  • Response to chemotherapy protocol (FOLFIRI + Bevacizumab)
  • Imaging response assessment using RECIST criteria
  • Tumor marker trends (CEA)
  • Comparison to clinical trials and literature

Prognostic Analysis

  • Stage IV disease factors
  • Genomic predictors
  • Performance status impact
  • Comorbidity effects

Outcome Tracking

  • Progression-free survival (PFS)
  • Overall survival (OS)
  • Quality of life assessments
  • Treatment tolerance

Research & Literature

  • Relevant clinical trials
  • Published outcomes for similar cases
  • Treatment option analysis
  • Evidence-based medicine review

Analysis Methodology

Analyses use:

  • RECIST v1.1 for imaging response
  • Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) for side effects
  • Performance status scales (ECOG, Karnofsky)
  • Standard prognostic scoring systems

Data Integration

Clinical analysis integrates:

  • Imaging findings
  • Laboratory trends
  • Provider assessments
  • Patient-reported outcomes
  • Published literature

Individual analysis documents provide comprehensive reviews of specific topics and treatment phases.
